{07 16 00}I need some cool clothes,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}. {01 00 00 0a 00}Yeah! I totally
need a superhero outfit!

{07 0b 00}What kind of clothes are
you into, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}I'm always into devising
disguises for my superhero
alter ego.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Missugused riided sulle
meeldivad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 14 00}Mina mõtlen alati välja
maskeeringuid oma
superkangelase teisikule.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Sometimes, I like to tie a
towel around my neck and
put a mask on and yell:
{07 0d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}"Heee-ya!{01 00 00 14 00} Superhero
powers, activate!{01 00 00 0a 00} It's the
amazing {04 01 00} Boy!"

{07 16 00}Vahel meeldib mulle siduda
rätik kaela ümber ja panna
mask ette ning karjuda:
{07 0d 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}„Heee-jaa!{01 00 00 14 00} Kangelase
jõud, aktiveeru!{01 00 00 0a 00} See on
